messages.text: Record DEN-08 — what did the panoramic x-ray and the plan say?

Record DEN-08's orthopantomogram shows an impacted lower-left wisdom tooth lying close to the inferior alveolar nerve canal, with associated pericoronal infection. The plan documented is surgical removal under general anaesthetic with a coronectomy considered to reduce the nerve-injury risk, and antibiotics in the meantime.
